title: Sunway Healthcare extends gain by nearly 8% as investors buy into growth optimism
desc:
Sunway Healthcare Holdings Bhd (KL:SUNMED) rose again on Friday as investors bought into growth optimism of one of the country’s largest hospital operators.
Shares of Sunway Healthcare rose as much as 19 sen or over 8% to RM2.46. The stock paused for the midday trading break at RM2.40, set for consecutive days of gains since listing five days ago. Trading volume was also high with nearly 80 million shares changed hands.
